AMBUSH_CAPACITY_POWER.title: Ambush Capacity
AMBUSH_CAPACITY_POWER.description: Your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] capacity equals this power's stacks. The first [gold]Power[/gold] card you play each turn raises it by 1.
AMBUSH_CAPACITY_POWER.smartDescription: Your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] capacity is [blue]{Amount}[/blue]; +1 for the first [gold]Power[/gold] card you play each turn.
AMBUSH_ZONE_POWER.title: Ambush Zone
AMBUSH_ZONE_POWER.description: There are cards in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold]. Attacks grant [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and Skills grant [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold]; Powers grant no bonus. Outside ambush form, each card you play brings out the earliest added card for free.
AMBUSH_ZONE_POWER.smartDescription: [blue]{Amount:abs()}[/blue] cards are in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold]. Attacks grant [gold]Strength[/gold] and Skills grant [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
REND_POWER.title: Rend
REND_POWER.description: Whenever this creature takes attack damage, it takes additional damage equal to its stacks. Removed at the end of your turn.
REND_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever this creature takes attack damage, it takes an additional {Amount} [gold]damage[/gold]. Removed at the end of the turn.
FROSTBITE_POWER.title: Frostbite
FROSTBITE_POWER.description: When [gold]Frostbite[/gold] is applied or stacked, this creature immediately takes {Amount} damage, then its stacks are halved (rounded up). If its HP is not higher than its [gold]Frostbite[/gold] stacks, it dies instantly.
FROSTBITE_POWER.smartDescription: When applied, immediately takes {Amount} [gold]damage[/gold], then its stacks are halved (rounded up). Dies instantly if HP is not higher than {Amount}.
FROZEN_ADEPT_POWER.title: Frozen Mastery
FROZEN_ADEPT_POWER.description: This turn, whenever [gold]Frostbite[/gold] triggers damage, it deals damage [blue]{Amount}[/blue] additional time(s).
FROZEN_ADEPT_POWER.smartDescription: This turn, [gold]Frostbite[/gold] damage triggers {Amount} additional time(s).
OVERLOAD_POWER.title: Overload
OVERLOAD_POWER.description: Cards in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] count as all types this turn. The zone is disabled next turn.
KILLER_INSTINCT_POWER.title: Ambush Instinct
KILLER_INSTINCT_POWER.description: The first time each turn you add a card into your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], gain 1 [gold]Energy[/gold]. The first time each turn you bring a card out of your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], draw cards equal to its stacks.
KILLER_INSTINCT_POWER.smartDescription: The first time each turn you add a card into your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], gain 1 [gold]Energy[/gold]. The first time each turn you bring a card out of your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], draw {Amount} cards.
AMBUSH_ECHO_POWER.title: Hidden Troops
AMBUSH_ECHO_POWER.description: Your [gold]Ambush[/gold] effects trigger an additional number of times equal to its stacks.
CALAMITY_FORM_POWER.title: Hunting Form
CALAMITY_FORM_POWER.description: Your attacks ignore [gold]Block[/gold]. At the start of your turn, apply 1 [gold]Opening[/gold] to ALL enemies.
CALAMITY_FORM_POWER.smartDescription: Your attacks ignore [gold]Block[/gold]. Apply 1 [gold]Opening[/gold] to ALL enemies at the start of your turn.
CALAMITY_MARK_POWER.title: Opening
CALAMITY_MARK_POWER.description: A creature with [gold]Opening[/gold] takes [blue]34%[/blue] more damage from ALL sources; when gained, randomly removes 1 [gold]buff[/gold] from itself.
CALAMITY_MARK_POWER.smartDescription: Takes [blue]34%[/blue] more damage from ALL sources for [blue]{Amount}[/blue] turn(s); when gained, randomly removes 1 [gold]buff[/gold] from itself.
TRACKED_POWER.title: Hunted
TRACKED_POWER.description: Cards brought out of your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] are forced to target this enemy and deal [blue]25%[/blue] more damage to it.
TRACKED_POWER.smartDescription: For [blue]{Amount}[/blue] turn(s), cards brought out of your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] are forced to target this enemy and deal [blue]25%[/blue] more damage to it.
WHET_CLAW_POWER.title: Whet Claws
WHET_CLAW_POWER.description: All copies of [gold]Whet Claws[/gold] deal more damage this combat, increased by its stacks.
WHET_CLAW_POWER.smartDescription: All copies of [gold]Whet Claws[/gold] deal {Amount} more damage this combat.
NIGHT_PATROL_POWER.title: Dark Harvest
NIGHT_PATROL_POWER.description: At the start of each turn, if there is a card in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], permanently gain [gold]Strength[/gold] and an equal amount of [gold]Dexterity[/gold], increased by its stacks.
NIGHT_PATROL_POWER.smartDescription: At the start of each turn, if there is a card in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], permanently gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
SNOWPACK_POWER.title: Snowpack
SNOWPACK_POWER.description: Whenever a card is added to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to its stacks.
SNOWPACK_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever a card is added to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], gain {Amount} [gold]Block[/gold].
CHAIN_POUNCE_POWER.title: Chain Pounce
CHAIN_POUNCE_POWER.description: This turn, the next few cards brought out of your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] are played an additional time, then [gold]Exhausted[/gold].
CHAIN_POUNCE_POWER.smartDescription: This turn, the next {Amount} cards brought out of your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] are played an additional time, then [gold]Exhausted[/gold].
ETERNAL_HUNT_POWER.title: Eternal Hunt
ETERNAL_HUNT_POWER.description: Each turn, you may add cards into your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] for free, up to a number equal to its stacks.
ETERNAL_HUNT_POWER.smartDescription: Each turn, you may add the first {Amount} card(s) into your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] for free.
ICE_ARMOR_POWER.title: Snow Veil
ICE_ARMOR_POWER.description: Whenever you apply [gold]Frostbite[/gold] to an enemy, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold]. Whenever you are attacked without losing HP, apply [gold]Frostbite[/gold] to ALL enemies ([blue]1[/blue] base, [blue]2[/blue] upgraded).
ICE_ARMOR_POWER.smartDescription: Gain {Amount} [gold]Block[/gold] whenever you apply [gold]Frostbite[/gold]; apply [gold]Frostbite[/gold] to ALL enemies when you are attacked without losing HP ([blue]1[/blue] base, [blue]2[/blue] upgraded).
FROST_INTENSIFY_POWER.title: Frost Intensify
FROST_INTENSIFY_POWER.description: Frostbite you apply has [blue]{Amount}[/blue] additional stacks; after each [gold]Frostbite[/gold] you apply, [blue]{Amount}[/blue] increases by 1.
FROST_INTENSIFY_POWER.smartDescription: Frostbite you apply has [blue]{Amount}[/blue] additional stacks (+1 after each application).
WINTER_MELT_POWER.title: Winter Melt
WINTER_MELT_POWER.description: The [gold]Frostbite[/gold] you apply to enemies no longer deals damage when it triggers, and its stacks no longer decrease.
WINTER_MELT_POWER.smartDescription: [gold]Frostbite[/gold] you apply to enemies triggers no damage and no longer loses stacks.
CARNIVAL_MOMENT_POWER.title: Carnival Moment
CARNIVAL_MOMENT_POWER.description: When you apply [gold]Frostbite[/gold], your next [gold]Frostbite[/gold] this turn gains +1 stack. Resets at the start of your turn.
CARNIVAL_MOMENT_POWER.smartDescription: Your next [gold]Frostbite[/gold] this turn gains +1 stack after each application (resets each turn).
SNOWFIELD_POWER.title: Snowfield
SNOWFIELD_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, add Snowballs equal to its stacks into your [gold]Hand[/gold] (upgraded: [gold]Big Snowballs[/gold]).
SNOWFIELD_POWER.smartDescription: At the start of your turn, add [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Snowball(s)[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold] (upgraded: [gold]Big Snowball(s)[/gold]).
FROST_CALAMITY_POWER.title: Frost Calamity
FROST_CALAMITY_POWER.description: Whenever an enemy with [gold]Frostbite[/gold] dies, the other surviving enemies each gain half of its stacks (rounded down).
FROST_CALAMITY_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever an enemy with [gold]Frostbite[/gold] dies, the other enemies each gain half of its stacks.
TING_QIAO_POWER.title: Tingqiao
TING_QIAO_POWER.description: You take [blue]60[/blue]% less damage. When an enemy attacks, [gold]first[/gold] deal damage to it equal to its intent's per-hit damage, increased by your [gold]Strength[/gold].
TING_QIAO_POWER.smartDescription: You take [blue]60[/blue]% less damage; when an enemy attacks, [gold]first[/gold] deal damage to it equal to its intent's per-hit damage, increased by your [gold]Strength[/gold].
CONCENTRATION_POWER.title: Concentration
CONCENTRATION_POWER.description: Your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] is disabled this turn.
ANIMAL_FRIENDS_POWER.title: Animal Friends
ANIMAL_FRIENDS_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, add a random [gold]Animal[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
STARGAZING_POWER.title: Stargazing
STARGAZING_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, look at the top 5 cards of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. You may put any number of them into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
ICE_AGE_POWER.title: Frost Sky
ICE_AGE_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, apply [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Frostbite[/gold] to ALL enemies.
FROST_THRONE_POWER.title: Frozen Throne
FROST_THRONE_POWER.description: The first time each turn you cannot afford a card's Energy cost, you may still play it. For each point of Energy you are short, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Frostbite[/gold].
DOTING_MOM_POWER.title: Doting Snow Leopard Mom
DOTING_MOM_POWER.description: This turn, whenever you are attacked, deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage back to the attacker.
SWARM_AMBUSH_POWER.title: Swarm Ambush
SWARM_AMBUSH_POWER.description: At the start of each turn, all allies gain [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold] equal to the number of Attacks and Skills in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], until the end of their turn.
SWARM_AMBUSH_GRANT_POWER.title: Swarm Ambush
SWARM_AMBUSH_GRANT_POWER.description: This turn you gain temporary [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold] from your ally's [gold]Swarm Ambush[/gold]. Lost at the end of your turn.
WILD_DOG_MILK_POWER.title: Eternal
WILD_DOG_MILK_POWER.description: When an [gold]Ambush[/gold] card is added to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], its [gold]Ambush[/gold] effect is unlocked immediately. (Does not affect zone shutdown.)
VAPE_POWER.title: Vape
VAPE_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, draw cards equal to its stacks.
VAPE_POWER.smartDescription: At the start of your turn, draw {Amount} card(s).
